name: Gurrea de Gállego (Spain)
description: Blue field with a red band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged with two yellow wolves passant at the upper fly and the lower hoist.
history: Municipal flag of Gurrea de Gállego; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
